hypothesis_text: Extreme 7-day return skewness (|return_skewness_7d| > 0.75) in major cryptocurrency perpetual futures (BTC and ETH) reflects severe distributional asymmetry driven by episodic tail events (lottery-demand buying surges or panic-driven sell-offs). When return skewness is highly positive, asset prices experience temporary upside overshooting due to aggressive speculative retail chasing, which subsequently mean-reverts downward over 1h to 4h horizons as momentum stalls and temporary price impact dissipates. Symmetrically, extreme negative skewness reflects panic liquidation or flash crashes that overshoot fundamental valuations, creating an asymmetric recovery rebound. This reversal effect is amplified under extreme volatility conditions (volatility_parkinson_1h tail gate) and aggressive order flow exhaustion (taker_buy_ratio_1h tail gate).
narrative: Over a 7-day window, return skewness captures whether the return distribution has been dominated by infrequent, large positive spikes (positive skewness) or sudden sharp crashes (negative skewness). In crypto derivatives markets, positive return skewness typically arises when speculative momentum buyers chase rapid price pumps, creating an overextension in price relative to resting liquidity. Once the initial surge exhausts the pool of willing aggressive buyers, market makers widen spreads and rebalance inventories, causing prices to mean-revert downward toward the multi-day volume-weighted average price. Conversely, extreme negative skewness marks episodes of sudden liquidation cascades and aggressive selling into a thinning bid book; once forced selling subsides, the absence of further panic orders allows liquidity providers to absorb the remaining overhang, triggering an upward rebound. The conditioning partners directly capture the market mechanics: (1) volatility_parkinson_1h (absorption role) via gate_tail identifies regimes where intraday high-low range volatility is in the outer tail, confirming that the multi-day skewness originated from genuine liquidity dislocation rather than noise; and (2) taker_buy_ratio_1h (trigger role) via gate_tail captures the exhaustion point where extreme aggressive order flow reaches a climax and fails to push prices further, enabling mean-reversion forces to dominate.
research_rationale: Anchor candidate XL_btc_eth_duo_e4bb2ed7930c establishes that extreme 7-day return skewness (|skew| > 0.75) matches 23,149 bars (28.5% rate) with 156 independent events across BTC and ETH over 240 active days. Return skewness displays wide empirical dispersion (mean -0.176, std 0.986, p05 -1.82, p95 +1.04). While scan-panel frequencies show robust sample size, in-sample event counts do not guarantee out-of-sample predictive efficacy; T1 observation unit certifies reach via event scoring (2,873 projected events at 60m), although projected daily scored days (135) fall below the 250 daily floor. In composition_plan, volatility_parkinson_1h (gate_tail) directly follows the absorption role in gene_knowledge.priors with 2 prior ledger trials both surviving T1, and taker_buy_ratio_1h (gate_tail) implements the prior trigger role with 30 ledger trials (5 T1 survivals). Both partners exhibit 1.0 panel coverage. Cemetery inspect_catalog reveals return_skewness_7d is completely untested (trials=0), representing virgin alpha territory. Search_scope full is selected to test authored gates alongside the automatic composition grid.
